correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md identifies alpha(R_mn)=m and omega(R_mn)=n, so existential independent/clique tests I_k,C_k of quantifier rank k<=q prove necessity. For sufficiency Duplicator preserves separately the equality pattern of chosen row coordinates and column coordinates, choosing previously paired values on repetitions or fresh ones otherwise. In at most q moves, both sides with size >=q never exhaust fresh values, while any smaller side is equal to its match; the induced selected-vertex map preserves equality and adjacency. This is an unrestricted q-round EF proof, not a finite-test extrapolation. The class predicates use I_a,C_b and negated I_(a+1),C_(b+1) only when truncations are <q. This yields exactly binomial(q,2) classes, sharp q^2 minimum representative for class (q,q), and minimal distinguishing rank. Independent explicit clique/independent enumeration confirmed small m,n<=4.
